fusions.name: Grub Raker
fusions.desc: Rakes the blade through the ground in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and throwing each enemy back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Deadfall
fusions.desc: Drops your whole weight behind the blade for 32 damage and leaves the target 18% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Winter Den
fusions.desc: You dig in and rest, regaining 4 health a second for 8 seconds. The healing rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Dig In Deeper
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
